question: Who among the following was appointed as the Governor of Jharkhand in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CP Radhakrishnan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **CP Radhakrishnan** is an Indian politician and member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has served as a Member of Parliament from Coimbatore.
 
• He was appointed as the Governor of Jharkhand in February 2023.
 
• CP Radhakrishnan has held several important positions within the BJP and has been actively involved in various social and political activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governorship in India**

 
 
• The Governor is the head of a state in India and is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The role of the Governor is largely ceremonial, but they have certain discretionary powers that can be significant in times of political instability.
 
• Governors are appointed for a term of five years but can remain in office at the pleasure of the President.
 
• The Governor's primary responsibility is to oversee the functioning of the state government and ensure that it operates within the framework of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**
 
 
• The BJP is one of the two major political parties in India and is known for its right-wing politics and nationalist ideologies.
 
• Founded in 1980, the BJP has grown to become the largest political party in terms of representation in the national parliament and state assemblies.
 
• The party's agenda includes economic liberalism, national security, and cultural nationalism.
 
• The BJP has produced several Prime Ministers, including the current Prime Minister, Narendra Modi.
